merges.why: All are services of one barbershop menu; one long page with a jump board replaces many thin pages. Father & son booking itself lives on Book online.
Walk-ins and appointments are two ways to get a chair and belong together; father & son and wedding party bookings are sections of this single booking page.
Both are group grooming packages for an event or organisation, with the same audience of group organisers.
All ordering goes in one place, and the product guide helps choose what is sold there.
Rules, policies and questions are one page.
Access and sensory-friendly information is part of preparing for a first appointment.
The space and the story are both parts of one About us page.
Events and charity days are community activities that fit one Community page.
Both address barbers seeking a place to work, so they sit together on Careers.

merged.why: Only three short sections (media mentions, awards, partner logos), not enough for a standalone page; it fits as a section on About us.

styleNotes: Classic barbershop character: dark charcoal or deep navy with warm leather, brass or cream accents.
Bold condensed or slab-serif headings paired with a clean readable sans-serif for body text.
Rich photography of real chairs, tools and finished cuts, with a subtle texture such as wood or tile.
Prominent sticky Book Now button and easy-to-scan price lists on mobile.
